'''October 2000 Virginia Beach tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in The Comic Alternative, Virginia Beach, VA on 22 October 2000. [[Lincoln Torrey]] won it. It is known from Mark Balderston's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1390">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-10-26-va-beach-va-comic-alternativa-10-22-00d1390/ va-beach-va-comic-alternativa-10-22-00], DeckTech (Mark "Rogue Nine" Balderston, 26 October 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-10-26-va-beach-va-comic-alternativa-10-22-00d1390/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 22 October 2000
* '''Site:''' The Comic Alternative, Virginia Beach, VA
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Death Star II]]
* '''Winner:''' [[Lincoln Torrey]]
